name: MonarchMarketingHero
title: MarketingHero
wrapsNative: VStack of Text with the display type role, MonarchFlowLayout for the actions, a LinearGradient backdrop
summary: The opening of a welcome, onboarding or upgrade screen: an eyebrow, a large title, a lead sentence, one or two actions and a short note, over a soft accent wash.
whenToUse: At the top of a first-run, welcome or upgrade screen that introduces the product before anything else.
whenNotToUse: For the title of an ordinary screen, use the navigation title. For a short empty or error message, use MonarchEmptyState.
api: init(_ title: String, eyebrow: String? = nil, lead: String? = nil, note: String? = nil, alignment: MonarchMarketingAlignment = .center, showsBackdrop: Bool = true, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)
init(_ title: String, eyebrow: String? = nil, lead: String? = nil, note: String? = nil, alignment: MonarchMarketingAlignment = .center, showsBackdrop: Bool = true)  // where Actions == EmptyView

options.name: title
options.description: The headline, in the display type role.

options.name: eyebrow
options.description: A short label above the title in the accent's strong colour, such as the product name.

options.name: lead
options.description: One or two sentences under the title.

options.name: alignment
options.description: Centred or leading text and actions.

options.name: showsBackdrop
options.description: Draws the accent's subtle colour behind the text, fading to clear.

options.name: actions
options.description: One or two buttons, the first one primary.

states.name: centred
states.description: Text and actions are centred; the actions wrap onto centred rows.

states.name: leading
states.description: Text and actions start at the leading edge.

states.name: without backdrop
states.description: No accent wash; the screen's background shows.

appearance: The title uses the display role in the default text colour, the eyebrow the accent's strong colour, the lead and the note the muted text colour. The backdrop fades from the accent's subtle colour to clear. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web hero sets the page's h1 and uses fluid display type sized by the viewport. On iOS the title is a heading in the display role, which follows Dynamic Type instead of the screen width, and the hero sits inside the screen's scroll view. There is no page heading level to choose. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: The title has the header trait; the eyebrow is read before it, then the lead.
Each action stays its own button; the note is read last.
All text wraps and grows with Dynamic Type; nothing is truncated.
The backdrop is hidden from VoiceOver.
edgeCases: At the accessibility sizes the title takes several lines; keep it short.
More than two actions wrap onto further rows.
